{"code": "import numpy as np

# Perform a stratified analysis to check for confounding by severity, age, and site
# First, compute mean change by sex within each severity level in the treatment arm
treatment_by_severity = treatment_data.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['change'].mean().unstack(fill_value=np.nan)
print('Mean change by sex and severity (treatment arm):')
print(treatment_by_severity)

# Compute mean change by sex within each site
treatment_by_site = treatment_data.groupby(['sex', 'site'])['change'].mean().unstack(fill_value=np.nan)
print('\nMean change by sex and site (treatment arm):')
print(treatment_by_site)

# Compute mean change by sex within each age group (split at median age)
median_age = treatment_data['age'].median()
treatment_data['age_group'] = np.where(treatment_data['age'] <= median_age, '≤55', '>55')
treatment_by_age = treatment_data.groupby(['sex', 'age_group'])['change'].mean().unstack(fill_value=np.nan)
print('\nMean change by sex and age group (treatment arm):')
print(treatment_by_age)"}
